summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with dizziness and hypotension following CMV viremia and recent discontinuation of valcyte. She was found to be anemic and received blood transfusions, though her hematocrit response was suboptimal. A urinary tract infection caused by vancomycin-sensitive Enterococcus faecium was treated with linezolid due to allergy. Her kidney function worsened despite uncapting the nephrostomy tube, leading to restart of dialysis after a successful fistulogram to address AV fistula stenosis. CMV viral load improved with ganciclovir and transition to valcyte. Atrial fibrillation recurred after holding metoprolol but was controlled upon restart. Warfarin was held for the procedure and resumed at discharge. Tacrolimus was adjusted for elevated levels. She was discharged home on antibiotics, antivirals, and dialysis with follow-up planned.
